title: APMCraft
description: Track your APM! APMCraft adds a real-time APM (Actions Per Minute) counter to Minecraft, inspired by StarCraft II and Warcraft III. Track your live APM and peak APM as you play, whether you're fighting, building, or just spamming for fun.
body:
A very simple mod that I made to track my APM while playing Acrobat on WynnCraft.

APMCraft adds a real-time APM (Actions Per Minute) counter to Minecraft, inspired by StarCraft II, Warcraft III, and Desktop APM.

Track your live APM and peak APM as you play, whether you're fighting, building, or just spamming for fun.

Customize the display using ModMenu. You can move it anywhere on your screen and toggle live or peak APM on/off.

All mouse clicks and key presses count toward your APM, even while in menus. This ensures speedrunners, including those who rely on the escape menu and fast inventory interactions, are fully tracked.

APM tracking is only paused when chat is open or when the game is unfocused.

This mod is designed for fun, not to track your effective APM (meaningful actions). So go ahead and mash your way to insane APM numbers.

**Please note that like most APM trackers, your numbers will stabilize and appear more “normal” after about 60 seconds of gameplay.**
